# EnzymeCore release notes

All notable changes to EnzymeCore.jl are documented in this file.
The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/).

For releases up to and including v0.8.28, see the [GitHub releases](https://github.com/EnzymeAD/Enzyme.jl/releases).

## Unreleased

### Fixed

- `EnzymeRules.has_frule_from_sig` and `EnzymeRules.has_rrule_from_sig` did not find a rule when the signature has `where` variables, for example `Tuple{F, Float64} where {F <: Function}` [#4134].
